facts.fact: ITWeb Africa reports Nigeria's Federal Government began full rollout of the 1Gov sovereign cloud (GovDrive, GovECMS, GovMail, GovE-Sign) implemented through state company Galaxy Backbone across ministries including Communications, Justice, Foreign Affairs, Solid Minerals and Intergovernmental Affairs.

systems.platform: sovereign cloud with GovDrive, GovECMS, GovMail, GovE-Sign
